HG06-emuA:
Protecting Yourself from Hypnotists

Hypnotism can happen in a controlled environment with a therapist, but it can also be utilized through music, marketing, religious rituals, sexual chemistry, charismatic authority, social media, grief, fear, political messaging, sense of belonging, fatigue, love, trauma, beauty, etc.

Even when not actively engaging the conscious mind, there are many ways to influence people. Marketers and interface designers have been using these techniques for years, and the practice has even come under scrutiny by regulatory bodies. In the Federal Trade Commission’s report on “dark patterns,” they refer to “design patterns that have been designed to trick or manipulate users into doing things that they might not otherwise do.” The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) refers to “dark patterns” as “any online pattern that uses deceptive, coercive, or manipulative means to compel users to perform unwanted actions.”

Consciously or unconsciously, emotionally or legally, there are a lot of ways to gain someone’s consent, or influence their mind, even if they are a fully grown adult.

As the practitioners of the Silva Method of Mind Control say,

“If you don’t learn to control your mind, someone else will!”

Since there are a lot of forces out there trying to train your mind, via ads, fear, craving, screens, tribe, resentment, authority, loneliness, and repetition, you can use self-hypnosis techniques to learn to befriend your deeper mind, and choose things for yourself as a fully conscious adult.
HG07-emuA:
The Most Extreme Example

I can tell you one shocking personal story that will make you never trust hypnotists again who maintain that you can’t be manipulated through hypnotism:

My friend P. has a friend named V. V. is a 33rd-degree Free Mason. V. has the ability to get anyone to strip naked and have sex with him within 3 seconds, even via phone call. How is this possible? The only way it could be possible, that I know of, is if people are already hypnotized by mass media/devices with a trigger word that is known by the elites.

Under no circumstances allow a strong emotional state, charismatic individual, sexual charge, spiritual experience, or other authority to replace the adult part of yourself. All legitimate forms of influence can stand up to scrutiny.
HG10-emuA:
Hypnosis Evidence

Is there REAL (not magical) evidence for Hypnosis? Yes. In 2024 there has been an overview of 49 meta analyses containing a total of 261 distinct primary studies. Evidence was strongest for pain, medical procedures, and work with children and adolescents, but varied with different outcomes and study design quality.

Is there evidence for Self-Hypnosis? Yes. There has been a systematic review of Randomized Controlled Trials of self-hypnosis, finding benefit in studies of pain, child birth, pediatric, stress, anxiety etc. Self-hypnosis tends to be more useful when done as a real self-skill several times, not just listening to an audio file.

Here I will be teaching you a real self-skill, not just asking you to buy more audio trance files.

Mayo Clinic cautions that if you use hypnosis in the context of stressful past life events and have strong reactions to this, then hypnosis may not be the best treatment to deal with historical trauma, other treatments may be more suitable.

Use Self-Hypnosis for: regulation, dialogue, reparenting, clarity, habit change, present life safety, emotional integration, present life action

Don't use Self-Hypnosis for: forcing trauma memories, proof of trauma memories, suppressing medical symptoms, destabilizing yourself, instead of correct treatment
HG11-emuA:
Forget the left-brain/right-brain cartoon

I put the phrase syncing the hemispheres in quotation marks because I don’t want to over-interpret what is going on neuroscientifically. It’s a very useful description but a large resting state fMRI study of 1011 people did not support the common pop- neuropsychological notion that people in general can be left or right brained, although there is certainly evidence for the lateralization of some functions or networks.

The invitation is to elicit a high level of cooperation between the verbal, analytical, imaginal, emotional, somatic, intuitive, relational, spiritual and whatever other modes you want to include. It’s not an electoral process; nobody needs to win!

The mind of love retains its warmth, the mind of analysis its brightness. The mind of intuition is neither denied nor accepted dogmatically. The mind of rationality is neither destructive nor inhibited. The body has a voice- it can say yes, no or not yet. The imagination has opened the field and the adult can choose how to act. There is peace but there is also precision.

Love without analysis becomes fantasy, analysis without love becomes sterile. Intuition without testing becomes delusion; testing without intuition becomes dead. These modes can each serve to modify the others.

And of course it’s got to be a powerful state that leads to greater goodness in your life!
HG22-emuA:
The weekly deeper practice

Practise this once or twice a week and spend a bit more time with it if that would be useful but don’t make the practice any stronger. Whenever it is useful just access Higher Self, or if that is not possible go to a neutral witnessing place and let it unfold, using any adult function that is necessary to recognise any bypassing that may be going on and always allowing for a full exit and any necessary normal action.

Wherever possible take any normal action immediately afterwards to impress on the subconscious that something has changed, otherwise it may think that because the dishes have not been done, despite all the internal meetings to do the dishes, that there is no point in doing them.
HG27-emuA:
Closing

Most of these things will become easier once you stop being afraid of your subconscious and your body, and when you stop fighting your analytical mind or whatever protector is up at the time.

Also, I’m far more concerned about you becoming a trustworthy adult than about how deep you can go into hypnosis.

Then listen to her when she wants to come closer. It’s easiest if you keep some of your promises to her, too, because then the guards can relax a bit. Work on loving yourself, so that your thought processes don’t fight it, and work on thinking about yourself, so that your love doesn’t slip off into fantasy. Work on applying this to your regular life, too, so that your adult can keep the promise.
